import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { test } from 'vitest';
test('does not receive the staff or pilot fixture', () => {
  assert.equal(process.env.E2E_DATABASE_URL, undefined);
  assert.equal(process.env.DATABASE_URL_RLS, undefined);
  assert.equal(process.env.REQUIRE_PILOT_SALES_CONTRACT, undefined);
  assert.equal(process.env.REQUIRE_PUBLIC_INTAKE_CONTRACT, undefined);
  assert.equal(process.env.REQUIRE_PILOT_IDENTITY_CONTRACT, undefined);
});
